title: Senior Sales Consultant
description:
Description
TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.
Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.
Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.
TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment
We are looking for a high energy, consultative Technical Senior Sales Consultant to work with a more advanced audience: experienced tech professionals who already work in the industry and are looking to deepen their expertise, switch specializations, or move into senior and higher paying roles. This is a step above our core B2C sales team. You'll be selling an advanced program to experienced engineers, so you need to hold a credible, peer-level conversation and be comfortable across the full arc of modern systems engineering (system design and architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and data, security, and production AI). You won't need to write code, but you must understand these concepts well enough to answer real questions, map the curriculum to the roles and salaries candidates are targeting, and earn the trust of people who have hands-on experience.
The best candidates for this position combine strong consultative sales skills with genuine comfort in technical conversations, and thrive on complex, high value deals rather than high volume transactional sales.
What you will do

• Operate as a full cycle sales consultant, engaging technically experienced prospects, qualifying their goals, and guiding them to a decision

• Hold credible, informed conversations about technical topics relevant to our advanced courses, without needing to defer every technical question elsewhere

• Present and articulate TripleTen 's value proposition for career advancement and skill deepening, tailored to an audience that already has industry experience

• Work closely with sales leadership to close complex, higher ticket deals and consistently meet or exceed quota

• Work closely with marketing to refine messaging and positioning for this more experienced audience

• Maintain accurate documentation of leads and pipeline progress using HubSpot

• Bring consultative rigor and technical credibility to a team built around trust and expertise

﻿Weekly Schedule:
11:00 AM - 8:00 PM (EST) Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM (EST) - 6:00 PM (EST) rotating Friday or Saturday
Requirements

• 3-5+ years of sales experience in complex, consultative, or high-ticket sales environments (B2B and B2C, EdTech, enterprise software, complex technical products, or similar)

• Some technical background or working knowledge of the tech industry (former engineers, IT sales professionals, or similar) is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated record of hitting sales and activity quota consistently in previous roles

• Strong discovery skills - able to diagnose a prospect's goals and gaps before pitching, not lead with a script.

• Comfortable closing high-ticket deals and handling price and financing objections (payment plans, financing options)

• Ability to build credibility and rapport with technically experienced prospects

• Sharp business acumen, prior experience using HubSpot preferred

• Fluent English (C1 or above)

• Passionate about helping experienced professionals advance their careers

• Excellent team member who puts the mission above themselves (is focused more on "getting things right" rather than having to "be right")

What we can offer you

• Base Compensation: $2,000/month + uncapped commission based on hitting monthly cash-in quota. Total monthly earnings typically range

title: Part-time Technical Support Specialist (Peru)
description:
As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll be a customer-facing member of our Tier 2 support team, handling product issues that require deeper troubleshooting or coordination beyond frontline support.
You’ll use company's procedures and diagnostic tools to investigate issues, guide customers through next steps by phone, email, and SMS, and coordinate with service partners when a field visit is needed. When an issue requires Engineering input, you’ll gather the relevant findings and provide a clear escalation. You’ll remain responsible for customer communication and follow-up as the case moves toward resolution.
Work schedule options:

• Option A: Sat + Sun, 9 am - 7 pm EST (2 days, 10 hrs each)

• Option B: Thurs - Sun, 4 pm - 9 pm EST (4 days, 5 hrs each)

What you'll own:

• Troubleshoot known product issues with customers using company's procedures and diagnostic tools.

• Ask effective diagnostic questions, document findings, and determine the appropriate next step.

• Own assigned cases through resolution, including timely customer updates and follow-up.

• Coordinate customers, service partners, and internal teams to arrange field visits and track outcomes.

• Escalate complex issues to Engineering with a clear summary of symptoms, troubleshooting completed, and supporting information.

• Maintain accurate case records in Zendesk, Jira, and other support systems.

• Identify gaps or recurring issues and help improve troubleshooting procedures, support documentation, and tools.

• Work closely with Customer Experience, Field, and Engineering as support processes evolve

Requirements

• 1-2+ years of customer support, phone-comfortable, and follows procedures well.

• Handles standard troubleshooting and escalates cleanly.

• A good fit for a "weekend warrior" pool.

• Spanish/English bilingual is strongly preferred.

Nice to have:

• HVAC experience is last on the nice-to-have list. Technical aptitude, critical thinking, and phone skills come first.
Benefits
Hireframe provides nearshore and offshore staffing solutions, operating as a remote-first organization with team members located in the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines. Our robust benefits package includes:

• Permanent remote work flexibility

• Dedicated coaches offer an extra channel of support and skill-building

title: Sr. BAW Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring a Senior BAW Software Engineer on the Sales and Marketing Systems team at BCBST!
In this role, you will help lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing support of a new platform that will replace a critical legacy solution supporting an insurance line of business. As a senior technical contributor, you will partner closely with an external implementation partner, architects, business stakeholders, and cross-functional delivery teams to build scalable enterprise workflow and decision-management solutions that support a significant portion of our membership. You will play a key role in establishing development standards, influencing solution architecture, mentoring team members, and helping the organization build long-term expertise in IBM workflow technologies as the team expands beyond its traditional Microsoft-based technology stack.

To be successful in this role, in addition to the core job requirements, you'll bring extensive hands-on experience developing and supporting enterprise workflow and business-rule solutions using IBM BAW/BPM and IBM ODM. You will be a strong candidate for this role if you have experience designing and implementing complex workflow components including processes, human services, coaches, dashboards, toolkits, reusable frameworks, and workflow orchestration capabilities; integrating enterprise applications through REST APIs, SOAP services, JMS/MQ messaging, and database technologies; and leading platform upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives. Strong experience with Java/J2EE, JavaScript, SQL, enterprise databases, production support, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and root cause analysis is highly valued. The ideal candidate will also bring experience with requirements gathering, technical estimation, architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring developers, and providing technical leadership within Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

Strong candidates will have:

•
IBM BAW/BPM: 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise workflow solutions using IBM BPM 8.x and/or IBM BAW 20.x, 21.x, or 24.x.

•
IBM ODM: 3+ years of hands-on IBM Operational Decision Manager experience, including developing and integrating business-rule and decision-management solutions with enterprise workflows.

•
Workflow solution components: Extensive experience developing Business Process Definitions and Processes, Human Services, Client-Side Human Services, Coaches, Coach Views, dashboards, UCAs, Business Objects, toolkits, reusable components, and exception-handling frameworks.

•
Enterprise integrations: Strong experience integrating IBM BAW and ODM solutions with internal and external systems through REST APIs, SOAP web services, JMS/MQ messaging, databases, and stored procedures.

•
Supporting technologies: Proficiency with Java/J2EE, JavaScript, SQL, and enterprise database platforms, including SQL Server and DB2. Data modeling experience is also highly valued.

•
Modernization and operational support: Experience leading IBM BAW upgrades and migrations, supporting deployments across Development, QA, UAT, and Production, and performing troubleshooting, performance tuning, optimization, and root cause analysis.

•
Technical leadership and delivery: Experience with formal requirements gathering including BABOK good practices, architecture reviews, solution design, and technical estimation while establishing coding standards, conducting code reviews, mentoring developers, and collaborating with business, architecture, QA, and infrastructure teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Note:

• This is a remote, work-from-home position, but the final round of interviews will take place on-site in our Chattanooga, TN office.

• The expected work schedule is Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

• Periodic on-call support responsibilities will be required once the platform is operational.

• Sponsorship is not availab

title: Manager, Treasury (2026-8083)
description:
The Manager of Treasury is responsible for overseeing the organization's daily cash management activities, short- and medium-term liquidity forecasting, banking relationships and account structures, and cash reconciliation processes. This role is instrumental in maintaining adequate liquidity to support business operations, maximizing returns on excess cash, and minimizing financing and borrowing costs.
The position also leads treasury-related process optimization initiatives, leveraging NetSuite, the company's ERP platform, to enhance efficiency, strengthen internal controls, improve cash visibility, and support strategic financial decision-making. The Manager of Treasury collaborates closely with Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to ensure effective cash flow management and alignment with organizational financial objectives.
Must be able to work the East Coast hours of Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:00pm comfortably.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Daily Cash Management

• Manage and monitor daily cash activity across all operating and disbursement accounts

• Ensure cash is positioned in the correct bank accounts to meet operational needs and minimize idle balances

• Execute daily/weekly transfers between accounts as needed, including funding of disbursement accounts

• Support wire and ACH payment processing, including dual-approval controls

Cash Forecasting

• Prepare and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, updated daily

• Analyze variances between forecasted and actual cash flows and adjust assumptions accordingly

• Forecast cash receipts and disbursements using AR/AP aging reports, historical trends, and knowledge of customer payment behavior and vendor payment terms

• Identify and clearly flag when borrowing or debt repayment will be needed based on projected cash position

• Partner with FP&A on liquidity assumptions for annual budget and long-range planning

Bank Structure & Reconciliation

• Assist in the design and implementation of a concentration account and zero balance account (ZBA) structure

• Perform or oversee reconciliation of all bank accounts (approximately 15 accounts), ensuring timely resolution of discrepancies

• Maintain relationships with banking partners and serve as a point of contact for day-to-day banking issues

Investment & Yield Optimization

• Research and recommend short-term investment vehicles (money market funds, sweep accounts, overnight investments, CDs, etc.) to maximize earnings on excess cash

• Monitor market rates and banking fee structures to ensure competitive terms

Debt & Credit Facility Management

• Manage debt covenant compliance monitoring

Internal Controls & Governance

title: Chief Engineer, Power Generation
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE ENERGY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Put solar, storage and gas in the ground at an install rate no one in the construction market has hit. We are building generation across multiple gigawatt sites at once, on a schedule traditional EPC delivery cannot meet.

- Secure supply at a scale and timeline the supply chain cannot meet, and reshore it ourselves. Cells, containers, transformers and turbines are all constrained, so we qualify new suppliers and stand up domestic capacity instead of waiting in line.

- Make solar, gas and storage combine into power steady enough to run AI workloads. A training run does not tolerate a dip, so the hybrid plant has to behave like firm generation even when the resource behind it does not.

- Clear balancing authority certification, firm load rights, permits and interconnection against long clocks and a shifting policy environment. These approvals sit on the critical path to every gigawatt, so we work them years ahead of the build.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the production system behind how Fluidstack builds generation, from module fabrication through field install and energization, as one standard set of work instructions repeated across concurrent gigawatt sites.

- Set takt time and line balance for module and skid manufacturing, then hold the line to it with standard work, andon escalation and first-pass yield targets rather than with expediting.

- Drive install rate and rework down in the field through kaizen events and value stream mapping run with the crews doing the work, at the site, on the shift.

- Take quality to the source at suppliers through process audits, error-proofing and joint improvement work on their floor, and fold every fix into the standard design through change control so the next site inherits it.

- Teach the method across the organization, coaching engineers, site leads and contractors through A3 problem solving so the system holds when you are not in the room.

The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

At Lila Sciences, you will develop and test safeguards that reduce societal risks from increasingly capable closed loop scientific AI. This is a high-priority individual contributor role for an engineer who has built safety interventions within the development and deployment of frontier models and wants to apply that experience to scientific models, agents, tools and laboratory-connected workflows.

You will work with domain scientists, risk researchers, evaluators and engineering teams to turn risk findings and policy requirements into effective interventions. title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Verstehe, wie Menschen arbeiten. Bau die Software, die ihre Arbeit besser macht.

Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Wir können direkt beobachten, wo Prozesse haken, welche Informationen fehlen und was Menschen unnötig Zeit kostet.

Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen.

WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST

- Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen: Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen.

- Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen: Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen.

- Die Roadmap gestalten: Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich.

- Lösungen entwickeln: Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.

- Zusammenhänge durchdringen: Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind - und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben.

- Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt.

- KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe: Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss.

- Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten: Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss.

- Gutes Produkturteil: Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe.

- Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme: Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen.

- Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz: Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus.

- Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit: Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung.

- Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise: Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran.

Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein - wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe.

WARUM DU BEI BUENA EINSTEIGEN SOLLTEST

- Du bist nah am Problem: Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert.

- Du gestaltest das Produkt mit: In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

- Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag: Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung.

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team: Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 50

Working directly with our Revenue Operations leader and closely with Success leadership, you will turn company priorities into goals, compensation plans, and practical ways of working. The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). • Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• 401K

• Supplies and other perks

• Malpractice coverage

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
As Certara continues to grow, our Finance organization plays a critical role in translating that growth into clear, accurate, and timely information - both for the leaders who run the business day to day and for the investors and regulators who rely on our public filings. We're looking for a Manager, Financial Reporting who can move comfortably between both worlds: building the internal management reporting that helps leadership make decisions, and preparing the external SEC reporting that keeps us compliant, transparent, and audit-ready.
Position Summary
This is a dual-mandate role. You'll split your time between the mechanics of quarterly and annual SEC filings and the ongoing rhythm of internal management reporting - supporting board and executive decks, monthly financial packages, and KPI reporting used across the business. You'll work closely with Accounting, FP&A, SEC reporting, and the Business Unit finance leaders, and you'll be a key contributor to how Certara tells its financial story, internally and externally.

SEC & External Reporting

• Provide support schedules for and review the Company's periodic SEC filings (10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, proxy materials), including financial statements, footnotes, and MD&A

• Coordinate the quarterly and annual close and reporting timeline with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, and external auditors to ensure filings are accurate and on schedule

• Monitor emerging SEC and FASB guidance, assess impact on Certara 's reporting, and help implement process to support new disclosure requirements

• Support the external audit process, including responding to auditor requests and resolving open items

Internal Management Reporting

• Develop and maintain recurring KPI and BU reporting used by business unit and corporate leadership

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes, including consolidation and reporting tools

• Serve as a liaison between the accounting close process and the business, ensuring management reporting reconciles cleanly to the general ledger and external filings

Cross-Functional & Process

• Help maintain internal controls (SOX) relevant to the financial close and reporting cycle

• Support ad hoc projects such as acquisition integration reporting, new accounting standard implementation, and process improvement initiatives

• Act as a point of contact across Accounting, FP&A, and SEC Reporting to keep internal and external reporting consistent

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA strongly preferred??

• 5-8 years of progressive experience in accounting or financial reporting, with meaningful exposure to SEC reporting (public company or Big 4/public accounting background preferred)

• Working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting requirements; exposure to XBRL a

title: Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Position Title: Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer
Location: Remote (In the U.S)
Other Considerations: U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)
Position is contingent on contract award
POSITION SUMMARY
Sprezzatura is seeking a Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer to support cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VA.gov Platform.
The Security Automation / Data Engineer will design, develop, and implement automation that improves how security compliance data is collected, assessed, measured, and reported across a large-scale digital platform. This role will help transform repeatable, manual security and compliance activities into sustainable, engineering-driven capabilities that provide greater visibility into security posture and reduce the operational burden associated with maintaining compliance.
Working alongside security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, this position will focus on automated evidence collection and controls assessment, security data integration, compliance measurement, vulnerability and remediation reporting, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) capabilities, and security posture dashboards.
The ideal candidate combines cybersecurity knowledge with strong automation and data engineering skills and is comfortable integrating information across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tools, APIs, and compliance systems.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, develop, and maintain automated processes for collecting security and compliance evidence from authoritative system, infrastructure, configuration, and security data sources

• Develop automation to support security control assessment and continuous monitoring, including OSCAL-based evidence collection and control-assessment capabilities

• Build integrations and data pipelines that aggregate and normalize security information from multiple tools, platforms, and APIs

• Develop security metrics and dashboards that provide near-real-time visibility into control posture, remediation status, vulnerabilities, and other security indicators

• Automate recurring security and compliance reporting for security teams, engineering teams, program leadership, and government stakeholders

• Develop capabilities for measuring security-control and security-tooling coverage across applications, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines

• Automate vulnerability and remediation reporting to support prioritization, ownership, aging analysis, and tracking through closure

• Support implementation and operation of an SBOM capability, including collection and analysis of software dependency and third-party component data

• Integrate SBOM and software supply-chain information with vulnerability management and security reporting capabilities

• Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to ensure security controls implemented within CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure generate usable, repeatable compliance evidence

• Identify manual security and compliance processes that are candidates for automation and implement scalable solutions where feasible

• Support the development of repeatable processes that enable product and engineering teams to demonstrate continued compliance with defined security standards

• Ensure automated security evidence, metrics, and reporting are traceable, maintainable, and usable during ongoing compliance activities and independent controls assessments

• Document automation, integrations, data sources, processes, and technical solutions to support long-term sustainment by the Platform Security team

• Collaborate with security engineers, cybersecurity/RMF specialists, DevSecOps engineers, software engineers, product teams, and government stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate's degree and four (4) years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant experience.

• Five (5) years of experience as a Cyber Security Engineer may be substituted in lieu of a degree

The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.

As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. title: FP&A Sr Expert - New Geographies
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an FP&A Senior Expert to lead financial planning and analysis for the businesses Nubank is building beyond its core Latin American markets. Today that means Nu US and Nu Global. You will be the finance owner for these businesses and for new geographies from the first business case through launch: building their P&Ls, standing up planning and forecasting, and giving leadership a clear, independent view of whether each business is on track.

This role is not about maintaining an established forecast. New businesses start with little operating history, product plans that are still taking shape, and legal and regulatory structures that are still being defined. You will build the financial model of a business before it has data, decide which assumptions matter most, and revise them as the business learns. The scope covers every product we offer in these markets, including credit card, lending, banking, and international money movement.

The role is designed to move with Nubank's expansion. As a business matures, its FP&A transitions into a permanent structure and you take on the next new market. You will also lead the financial analysis behind opportunities the company is evaluating, so you will be part of the conversation about where Nubank goes next.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and consistent exposure to senior leadership, including the executives who run these businesses. You will be expected to hold a position when the analysis supports it, push back with evidence, and take direct feedback.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will be the technical lead for a small team of up to three analysts, setting the standard for their work and developing them while staying hands-on in the models and analysis yourself.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Own the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles for Nu US and Nu Global, with full accountability for the integrity of the numbers and for the position Finance takes on them with leadership.

- Build financial services P&Ls from first principles across credit, banking, and payments products, and model how product, pricing, and funding decisions flow through to each business's results and to Nubank's consolidated P&L.

- Lead the financial evaluation of new markets and products: unit economics, capital and funding requirements, the effect of legal entity and licensing structures, and the business case presented to senior leadership.

- Bring deep expertise in cross-border money movement, including FX, funds-in and funds-out costs, card network economics, and stablecoin rails, and become the reference on these topics across Finance.

- Partner with the leaders of the new businesses, bringing the finance perspective into pricing, product, and investment decisions early enough to shape them.

- Prepare clear, concise executive materials that simplify complex topics, often on short timelines.

- Set the analytical standard for the team: coach analysts, review their work, and build the processes and documentation that let each business's FP&A transition cleanly once it matures.

- Drive the use of AI, advanced analytics, and automation in planning and analysis, while keeping the judgment to review and challenge AI-generated output.

title: SDR Manager
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SDR Manager to lead our growing SDR team. This individual will be responsible for managing and scaling our outbound pipeline generation efforts while coaching and developing a high-performing team of SDRs.

This is a high-impact role that will sit at the center of our go-to-market motion. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to refine our outbound strategy, improve conversion rates, and ensure the SDR team consistently generates qualified pipeline as we continue expanding our presence.

This role requires 3 days in our NYC office

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on. You will:

- Manage, coach, and develop a global team of SDRs responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline

- Build and optimize outbound prospecting strategies across target accounts, regions and verticals, including signal-based programs driven by market events and 9fin content

- Partner closely with AEs to create targeted outbound campaigns and define the SDR-to-AE handoff, including qualification standards (MEDDPICC-aligned), SLAs and meeting quality feedback

- Work closely with Marketing, ABM and Demand Generation to plan and execute campaigns (content, events, webinars, and market-driven outreach)

- Develop and refine SDR playbooks, messaging frameworks, and outreach cadences, and test what works by region

- Design and scale AI-enabled prospecting and account research workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, Clay) across the team

- Manage account tiering, territory and coverage models

- Monitor and improve key SDR performance metrics including activity levels, meeting conversion rates, and pipeline generated, and work with RevOps to build reporting, forecasting, and performance dashboards

- Own SDR hiring, onboarding and ramp

- Build in-role career development plans and milestones for SDRs, with clear paths into AE and other GTM roles

- Support SDR career development through training, Gong call reviews, role-plays, and regular coaching

- Evaluate and manage the external tech tools used across Sales and Marketing teams (Clay, Gong Engage, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), and stay up to date with the key dynamics shaping the global Leveraged Finance, Private Credit, and Structured Finance markets

ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you have:

- Prior experience managing SDR/BDR team(s) or leading sales development functions, ideally 2+ years management experience, including distributed or multi-region teams

- 4+ years of experience in sales development, pipeline generation, or related go-to-market roles

- Strong experience with outbound prospecting strategies and pipeline generation, including ABM-aligned and signal-based outbound

- Experience working with Salesforce (or other CRM systems), Gong (Engage or other sales engagement platforms), Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hubspot, lead generation platforms, and Excel/G Suite

- AI fluency, with hands-on experience using Claude, ChatGPT or similar

title: Key Account Executive -Gurugram (Contractual)
description:

This is a field-heavy, high-ownership role. You will source and sign new rest stops on active and upcoming corridors, negotiate fixed-fee and revenue-share deals, keep collections and compliance on track, and develop new ways to create value from FlixBus's daily passenger touchpoints. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager and present performance, risks and opportunities to senior leadership.

About the Role

• Identify, evaluate and onboard new highway rest stops on active and upcoming FlixBus corridors, conducting site visits to assess hygiene, footfall, accessibility and brand fit.

• Negotiate fixed-fee and revenue-share agreements with rest stop operators that are commercially sound and build long-term, sustainable partnerships.

• Own the full onboarding lifecycle - from first contact to signed agreement, system entry and compliance activation.

• Track monthly collections across all active stops, flag shortfalls early and drive recovery, escalating to bus partner POCs where needed.

• Maintain a clear compliance framework with defined metrics, escalation protocols and partner-level accountability.

• Build and update dashboards and reports that give leadership real-time visibility into revenue, compliance health and programme trends, while keeping data across all tracking tools accurate.

• Drive geographic expansion corridor by corridor - mapping opportunities, prioritising by revenue potential and executing the rollout independently, including seasonal, expressway and off-peak transitions.

• Develop new on-ground monetisation opportunities such as onboard branding, co-branded rest areas, FMCG or F&B partnerships and last-mile tie-ups; build business cases, pilot them on a defined corridor and recommend whether to scale or exit.

• Keep a close eye on commercial approaches in the wider mobility and travel industry and bring relevant ideas back into FlixBus’s strategy.

About You

• 2-4 years of experience in business development, commercial partnerships, field operations or programme management - ideally in mobility, logistics, FMCG, hospitality or a start-up environment.

• A Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

• Proven ability to own a commercial relationship end to end: sourcing, negotiating, signing and managing, including closing deals independently with small business owners.

• A structured mindset, with the ability to build frameworks, pipelines and trackers from scratch.

• Comfort working with data: Excel or Google Sheets, basic dashboards and presenting numbers clearly to leadership.

• Excellent communication in Hindi and English for vendor dealings and internal reporting.

• Willingness to travel extensively across Indian highway corridors.

• Familiarity with the Indian intercity bus, highway hospitality or travel retail landscape.

• Experience piloting new revenue streams or brand partnerships.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up environment.

• Real ownership of a programme that directly shapes the passenger experience and revenue across India’s highway corridors.

• Exposure to senior leadership and the chance to pilot and scale new monetisation ideas.

title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) - Newton, MA
description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

title: Manufacturing Auditor
description:
Manufacturing Auditor
📍 On-Site | Aerospace Manufacturing 💰 $28-$34/hour, depending on experience 🕐 Full-Time | Flexible Hours 🌟 Benefits Available
About the Role
A locally owned Aerospace Manufacturing Company is looking for an experienced Manufacturing Auditor to join our Engineering/Manufacturing team.
This is a hands-on quality role focused on ensuring manufacturing processes, inspection practices, and documentation meet customer and company standards. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical inspection experience, excellent GD&T and blueprint reading skills, and the confidence to work directly with machinists, supervisors, engineering, and management.
What You'll Do
Perform in-process and floor audits at CNC machines and throughout the manufacturing area.
Verify machinists are using the correct blueprint revisions, tooling, CNC programs, and Net-Inspect information.
Review parts and dimensions using precision inspection equipment.
Verify inspection tools and gauges-including micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, thread gauges, dial indicators, air gauges, and CNC probes-are properly calibrated and used.
Review SOPs, traveler routing sheets, and manufacturing processes for compliance.
Investigate first-article and inspection discrepancies using available measurement equipment.
Review previous quality issues, scrap information, SPC trends, and Net-Inspect data to identify potential problems.
Monitor 5S, safety, and FOD prevention throughout the manufacturing floor.
Document audit findings and maintain daily audit/shift records.
Participate in root cause analysis and CAPA activities, including the use of 5 Whys.
Communicate quality trends and recurring issues to machinists, programmers, shop foremen, Engineering, and Quality.
Help train employees on proper inspection equipment use and manufacturing principles.
What We're Looking For
Required:
5+ years of mechanical inspection experience
Strong GD&T and complex blueprint reading skills
Experience with precision measurement and inspection equipment
Knowledge of surface plate setup and inspection techniques
Strong understanding of shop math and mechanical principles
Ability to use and interpret SPC and Six Sigma tools
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to remain objective and unbiased when conducting audits
Preferred:
CMM experience
Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or AS9102
Experience with problem-solving and corrective action
CQT or CMI certification
Experience with Net-Inspect
Spanish language skills
The Right Person Will Be
🔍 Analytical - able to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and determine root causes. 🤝 People-Oriented - comfortable working with employees at all levels while maintaining professionalism and tact. 🎯 Objective - able to conduct unbiased audits and focus on company and customer requirements. 🛠️ Hands-On - confident using inspection equipment and investigating manufacturing issues. 📣 A Strong Communicator - able to clearly explain findings, provide feedback, and help employees improve.
Work Environment
This position works in a machine shop/manufacturing environment with exposure to manufacturing equipment and noise. The role involves standing, walking, leaning, and occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs.
Drug-Free & Smoke-Free Workplace
If you're an experienced quality/inspection professional looking for a hands-on role in aerospace manufacturing, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Product Manager - Zero-Day Protection
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Austin, TX, London, UK, New York, NY

New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.

As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 25% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.

Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

• Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.

• Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.

• Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.

• Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.

• Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.

• Partner with the Cloudflare Security Analyst team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Analysts provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.

• Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.

• Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.

Customer experience

• Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation

title: Research Engineer, Model Evaluation and Improvement
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re a team focused on making frontier AI models better at science. LLMs know an extraordinary amount of biology, but there’s still a large gap in reasoning for the real-world problems scientists face every day. We recently published some of our work here https://www.benchling.com/blog/can-llms-work-in-the-wet-lab.

You’ll build the datasets, evaluations, and systems that help close that gap. You’ll work with scientists to turn complex scientific work into rigorous tasks that models can learn from and be evaluated against. You’ll partner with leading AI labs to understand where models fail and how to improve them.

This is an early and rapidly evolving area. You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, biology, and frontier AI: finding tasks that are challenging for LLMs and valuable to scientists, designing evaluations that capture real scientific judgment, and building systems to create these tasks at scale.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build datasets for evaluating and improving frontier models, turning complex scientific data into high-quality tasks and environments for LLMs.

- Analyze model failure modes, running experiments across frontier models to understand where they struggle and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Build scalable data infrastructure, creating pipelines that curate, transform, and validate large volumes of scientific data into tasks for model evaluation and improvement.

- Collaborate with frontier AI labs, helping develop and evaluate new approaches for improving models on challenging scientific tasks.

- Work closely with scientists, translating expert judgment into problems and evaluation criteria that can reliably distinguish strong model behavior.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years at the intersection of biology and AI, with academic or industry experience evaluating and improving scientific models or LLMs for biological applications.

- Experience building with LLMs, with an intuition for where current models excel, where they struggle, and how to design systems around their capabilities.

- Curiosity and excitement about frontier AI, with a desire to understand and push the capabilities of rapidly improving models.

- Comfort working on ambiguous problems, where the playing field is rapidly shifting and the right technical approaches are still being discovered.

- Collaborative mindset, able to work closely with engineers, scientists, and external research partners.

- Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift and rapid experimentation is encouraged.

 

HOW WE WORK

We prioritize in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 5 days per week (Monday - Friday).

Carwow Group is building the go-to destination for car-changing, reaching drivers everywhere through a portfolio of automotive brands: Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

Shortlisted in the prestigious Culture 100 list of the top Growth companies to work for by Hyer; we also recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify, Bessemer Venture Partners, to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility - building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

As a Sales Consultant in the Sales Team, you are the main person guiding our customers into the auction and getting their car sold.

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.

ROLE SCOPE

- Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment safely to receive, move, stage, and ship critical infrastructure at high velocity.

- Load, unload, inspect, and organize incoming hardware, ensuring every shipment is accounted for and ready for deployment.

- Pick, pack, and deliver parts quickly and accurately so technicians and engineers always have what they need to keep the data center moving.

- Maintain an organized, clean, and deployment-ready warehouse, keeping inventory accessible and material flowing efficiently across the site.

- Support inventory counts, stock replenishment, and asset tracking with precision, helping maintain accurate inventory and preventing operational delays.
